title: Join Tampa’s Gasparilla pirate celebration
description: Tampa Bay’s Gasparilla celebration turns a pirate legend into a waterfront spectacle. Watch the flotilla arrive, then follow the energy into a parade of floats, marching groups, and elaborate pirate costumes. Find a comfortable viewing spot and let the city’s shared joke carry you through an afternoon of music and make-believe.
teaser: Watch pirate ships and a citywide parade take over Tampa.
goodToKnow: Confirm the current invasion and parade schedule; a reserved viewpoint can make a crowded day easier.
whyItMightDelightYou: The fun lies in how completely a whole city commits to its playful pirate story.
